command_line:
set -eu
cat > fit.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1L) stop("Expected exactly one tabular input")
stopifnot(is.function(stats::glm))
dat0 <- utils::read.delim(
  args[[1]],
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = "",
  comment.char = "",
  check.names = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN")
)
needed <- c("Efficacy", "BMI")
if (!all(needed %in% names(dat0))) {
  stop(paste("Required columns missing:", paste(setdiff(needed, names(dat0)), collapse = ", ")))
}
eff <- trimws(as.character(dat0[["Efficacy"]]))
bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(dat0[["BMI"]])))
keep <- !is.na(eff) & nzchar(eff) & !is.na(bmi)
dat <- data.frame(
  PR = as.integer(eff[keep] == "PR"),
  BMI = bmi[keep]
)
if (nrow(dat) == 0L) stop("No complete Efficacy/BMI observations")
if (length(unique(dat$PR)) != 2L) stop("PR indicator does not contain both classes")
fit <- stats::glm(PR ~ BMI, data = dat, family = stats::binomial(link = "logit"))
aic <- as.numeric(stats::AIC(fit))
out <- data.frame(
  metric = c("AIC", "n_complete", "n_PR", "formula", "family", "response_event", "predictor"),
  value = c(
    format(aic, digits = 17, scientific = TRUE),
    as.character(nrow(dat)),
    as.character(sum(dat$PR == 1L)),
    "PR ~ BMI",
    "binomial(link=logit)",
    "Efficacy == PR",
    "BMI"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
utils::write.table(out, file = "result.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
